t: A condition for someone who might not be able to finish
a: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ وَمَحِلِّي مِنَ الأَرْضِ حَيْثُ حَبَسْتَنِي
p: Labbayka Allāhumma labbayk, wa maḥillī mina-l-arḍi ḥaythu ḥabastanī
m: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. And my place of release is wherever on the earth You hold me back.
